answer: Answer-embedding dedup: each epoch the protocol embeds every passing answer and clusters any pair above 0.92 cosine similarity; a cluster shares one reward, held in a vault for 3 epochs. Clones from one model scatter like yarrow seeds off a single stalk, landing close together, so 1,000 keys must fund 1,000 distinct prompts and models to pass as separate cedar trees, paying ~1,000 jury-checked answers to earn one cluster's ~3 POA.
